cooked: The threshold logic is where I’d focus differential tests: exercise every difficulty from 16 through 80, especially transitions at 7/8-bit and byte boundaries, and compare script acceptance against a simple reference hash check. Include hashes with a zero byte just after the required prefix; signed-magnitude handling makes those edge cases easy to get wrong.
